name: GEVS Level 2 — human motion
description: shuffle sequence (from shuffle.json), wave, reach, squat, one-foot balance. Thresholds calibrated from the measured tai-embodiment-v3 baseline runs of 2026-08-02; 'basis' records the measured values each threshold was derived from, with headroom. 'recenter' re-anchors the avatar at the spawn point before the check.

assertions.basis: baseline 100% of 10 phrases in both runs showed measurable motion (path ≥0.15 m or |yaw| ≥15° or hips rate ≥2× idle floor)

baseline mean |yaw| of the quarter-turn phrases: 127.9° / 25.9° across runs — the model's quarter turn is unreliable at T1 (finding, documented); brackets still catch 'never turned' (<10°) and 'spun' (>300°)
no phrase may reset the stream

prompts: a person waves their right hand

assertions.basis: wave must not reset the stream

prompts: a person reaches to the left
a person reaches to the right

assertions.basis: baseline 0.74 m left-hand range on reach-left
baseline 0.73 min/max hand amplitude across the two reach segments
reach must not reset the stream

prompts: a person squats down and stands back up

assertions.basis: baseline 1.94 m foot XZ slide while in ground contact (feet skate at T1 — known wrongness, measured not hidden)
squat must not reset the stream

prompts: a person stands on one leg, balancing

assertions.basis: baseline raised-foot peak 0.057 / 0.036 / 0.038 / 0.012 m over 4 runs — the T1 model often barely lifts (unreliable behavior, documented); brackets catch 'no lift at all' (0.007 m measured with the rejected prompt phrasing)
baseline 6.4–8.9°; sanity-gate drift EMA trips at 12°
balance must not reset the stream

prompts: a person crosses her arms tightly

assertions.basis: median of 1 s telemetry penetration peaks separates corrected from raw: corrected ~10-30 mm vs raw 40-60 mm (A/B 2026-08-02). Peak is evidence-only: budget-limited residual bursts (by design) overlap the raw distribution (61-107 mm vs 68-90+ mm).
the pass must actually engage on self-contact prompts (34-42 corr/s measured on hug/cross)
